Then the system raises an incident to RW-RISK with message MSG-P7-010

  Scenario: AC15 Request for a closed case (exception X10)
    Given a case that is closed
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock returns a new approval requested for that case with decision D7.1
    When the router runs for decision D7.1
    Then no decision task is opened and the case status is not changed
    Then the mismatch is recorded with message MSG-P3-005

  Scenario: AC16 Decided event with no open decision task (exception X11)
    Given the case has no open decision task
    When an approval decided event arrives for the case
    Then the event is dropped with its ID recorded in the inbox and an entry in the log
    Then no status changes

  Scenario: AC17 Decision record cannot be written (exception X12)
    Given the local decision record cannot be written
    When an approval decided event arrives for the case
    Then nothing changes: the task, the timer and the status are not written
    Then MSG-P7-003 is recorded and the event stays on the topic for redelivery

  Scenario: AC18 Role without Case record R is refused (exception X13)
    Given a user who holds no role with Case record R
    When the user reads the case or the task list
    Then the system refuses the call with status 403 and message MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC19 One open decision task for a waiting case (BR13)
    Given the case status is "Waiting approval"
    When the router runs for an open approval
    Then the case has exactly one open decision task
    Then a case in any other status has no open decision task
